evidence.title: Convexity of the Le Roy parameter threshold

source_scope:
Fix a real $\gamma>1$. For $0<\alpha<1/\gamma$ define
$$B_\gamma(\alpha)=\inf\{\beta>0:z+\gamma(z^{\beta-\alpha}-z^\beta)\le1\ \text{for every }0<z<1\}.$$
Is the function $\alpha\mapsto B_\gamma(\alpha)$ convex on $(0,1/\gamma)$?

This is the separate final-paragraph question in Section 3, p.5, of Simon's arXiv v2. The linked paper proves convexity for every $\gamma>1$ by identifying the literal infimum with a finite positive supremum of convex perspectives. It does not resolve the different complete-monotonicity equivalence conjecture indexed as MathDB 349140.
